# Redacted Source/Stream mappings and state

A Source stores usage instances under config.streams[instanceId]. Each pins a published reusable Stream release. target.collectionId selects the dataset; mapping.recordId or recordIdPath identifies the Record; sampleEnabled controls history. Optional topicId is display placement, and directories organize the tree only.

Source configuration and same-ID source_state are separate rows. MCP exposes explicit mappings and selected health/ACK state, excluding credentials, auth headers, cursor contents, scripts and execution input. Shared acquisition uses Binding state/update and sourceRuntimeGet for observed status, page position and counts; cursor values remain redacted. A published release or online Source does not imply ingestion ran.

Source/state requires uns.source; Stream requires uns.stream. Reuse means distinct Source instances reference one release, not merged producer identities or inferred joins.
